A fresh visual check of the target panes is not possible from the uploaded screenshots: native-side-panel.png shows the guest start panel, while normal-target-after-open.png shows an unrelated research-brief page and open-panel control.
verdict_b_harness_quality_false_pass_ris.false_pass_risk: Low for the asserted DOM values and export invariance: the driver requires a trusted capture click, waits for the active Scrape/result panes, checks exact SEO values and groups, parses Schema JSON, and compares full exported payload fingerprints. Residual risk is that the pane content and its visual presentation were not captured for independent inspection; viewport evidence is emulated and does not demonstrate physical side-panel sizing.
verdict_b_harness_quality_false_pass_ris.actionable_finding: For a stronger visual peer record, upload screenshots captured while the SEO and Schema result panes are selected and include a contemporaneous viewport readout. No harness or product defect was found in this bounded run.
